data.description: Al Quoz: Where Art, Industry, and Community Thrive in the Heart of Dubai!

data.answer:
The residential side of Al Quoz Dubai UAE is home to a diverse mix of Emirati families and expatriates, while the commercial district thrives with factories, car showrooms, and warehouses. This unique balance makes Al Quoz a vibrant and versatile area catering to both residential and business needs.

As part of the Dubai 2040 city plan, the government has launched the Al Quoz Creative District, an ambitious project to establish a central hub and free zone for creative industries. This initiative will provide artists, designers, and other creatives with integrated spaces to live, work, exhibit, and market their creations. The district will also streamline business permits and visa issuance, making Al Quoz Dubai UAE a key player in the city’s evolving creative economy.

Registered operators in the Al Quoz Creative District can benefit from the exclusive membership program, offering fee exemptions on visas, licensing, and import/export. Affordable rent, logistical support, and tailored training programs will further empower start-ups in creative fields such as media, software, publishing, and design. This initiative supports the Dubai Creative Economy Strategy, positioning Al Quoz Dubai UAE as a global innovation hub by 2025, and attracting talent, entrepreneurs, and investors worldwide.

Residential properties in Al Quoz Dubai UAE cater to a wide range of preferences, offering apartments, spacious villas, and a few residential plots. Apartments here range from studios to 4-bedroom units, featuring modern layouts with master bedrooms, built-in wardrobes, en-suite bathrooms, and balconies with double-glazed windows. Larger apartments often include guest rooms and separate maid’s quarters, making them ideal for families.

For those seeking more space, villas in Al Quoz Dubai are available in 4 to 6-bedroom configurations. These luxurious homes come with features like private gardens, maid’s rooms, driver’s rooms, study spaces, and dedicated garages. Al Quoz 4 also offers a selection of townhouses, adding to the residential diversity. A few residential plots can be found in Al Quoz 1 and Al Quoz 2, catering to those looking to build custom homes.

In addition to its residential offerings, Al Quoz Dubai UAE is a thriving hub for commercial properties. The area hosts offices, retail shops, warehouses, factories, industrial lands, and showrooms, making it a key destination for businesses. With its mix of residential and commercial spaces, Al Quoz offers a dynamic environment for living and working.

Popular Buildings in Al Quoz Dubai

Al Quoz Dubai is home to several notable residential apartment complexes, offering a range of living options. Popular buildings include Al Khail Gate, which features modern apartments with community amenities, and Al Khail Heights, known for its spacious units and convenient location. 

These complexes cater to diverse residential needs, combining comfortable living spaces with proximity to key areas in the city.

Off-Plan Projects in Al Quoz

District One West by Nakheel

District One West by Nakheel is a highly anticipated development located near Al Quoz, offering an exclusive collection of luxurious villas. The project features stunning waterfront properties with expansive layouts and world-class amenities, including lush green parks, a crystal-clear lagoon, cycling tracks, and jogging paths. 

Designed for families seeking a tranquil lifestyle within proximity to Dubai’s vibrant cityscape, District One West combines modern architecture with serene surroundings. This community is part of the larger Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, providing seamless connectivity to key areas in Dubai.

Eye by Mag Group

Eye by Mag Group is a unique addition to the off-plan property market in Al Quoz Dubai, catering to urban professionals and investors. This mixed-use development features stylish apartments with contemporary designs, smart home technology, and panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline. 

The project is situated in a prime location, offering excellent connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Khail Road (E44), ensuring easy access to key business districts, retail destinations, and leisure attractions. Eye by Mag Group combines convenience and sophistication, making it a sought-after address in the city.

Keturah Reserve Apartments & Plots by Mag Group

Keturah Reserve Apartments & Plots by Mag Group bring a fresh perspective to luxury living in Al Quoz. This project offers a range of upscale apartments with thoughtfully designed interiors, emphasizing natural light and open spaces. 

The residential plots provide an opportunity for buyers to create bespoke homes within an exclusive gated community. Residents of Keturah Reserve enjoy access to premium amenities, including wellness-focused facilities, recreational areas, and landscaped gardens, fostering a holistic and sustainable lifestyle.

Keturah Reserve Standalone Villas by Mag Group

Keturah Reserve Standalone Villas by Mag Group redefines luxury living with their unique design and exceptional features. These villas are built with meticulous attention to detail, offering expansive layouts, private pools, and landscaped outdoor spaces. 

The development focuses on wellness and sustainability, incorporating biophilic design principles to promote a harmonious connection with nature. Located in Al Quoz, the standalone villas offer a serene retreat while remaining close to Dubai’s key attractions, making them ideal for families and investors looking for high-end properties in a prime location.

Each of these off-plan projects in Al Quoz Dubai UAE reflects the area’s growing prominence as a hub for luxurious residential communities and innovative real estate developments.

Renting a Property in Al Quoz

Al Quoz Dubai UAE offers a diverse selection of residential properties for rent, including both apartments and villas, catering to various lifestyle preferences.

Flats for Rent in Al Quoz

Apartments in Al Quoz range from studios to multi-bedroom units, with rental prices varying based on size, location, and amenities. For instance, studio apartments in Al Khail Heights are available for approximately AED 48,000 per year, offering modern living spaces with community facilities. 

Two-bedroom apartments can be found in Al Khail Gate, with rents around AED 60,000 annually, featuring family-friendly environments and convenient access to essential services. 

Villas for Rent in Al Quoz

Villas in Al Quoz are known for their spacious layouts and luxurious features. A 5-bedroom villa in Al Quoz 1, for example, may have an average rental price of AED 374,999 per year, offering amenities such as private gardens and swimming pools. 

Similarly, a 6-bedroom villa in Al Quoz 2 can be rented for approximately AED 380,000 annually, providing ample space suitable for larger families.

It's important to note that rental prices in Al Quoz can fluctuate based on factors such as property size, condition, and specific location within the community. Prospective tenants are advised to consult updated listings and work with reputable real estate agents to find properties that best suit their needs and budget.

Buying a Property in Al Quoz

Al Quoz Dubai UAE offers a range of residential properties for purchase, including apartments and villas. Studio apartments are available from approximately AED 460,000, while one-bedroom units average around AED 729,000.

Two-bedroom apartments can be found for about AED 1,340,000. Villas in Al Quoz are priced higher, with four-bedroom villas starting around AED 2,200,000. These prices can vary based on factors such as location, size, and amenities.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Quoz Dubai?

data.answer:
Life in Al Quoz Dubai offers a unique blend of industrial charm and residential comfort, with a thriving creative and cultural scene. The area provides easy access to key highways, modern amenities, and diverse property options, making it a dynamic community for families and professionals alike.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Al Quoz

Residents of Al Quoz Dubai enjoy convenient parking facilities. Apartments typically come with dedicated parking spaces, while villas feature covered parking spots, ensuring ample parking options for residents.

For public transport, the Onpassive Metro Station on the Red Line is the closest metro station, located just a 10-minute drive from Al Quoz. Bus commuters can access nearby stops, including Madinat Jumeirah 1 & 2 and Burj Al Arab Hotel 1 & 2, which are a 17 to 19-minute drive by car. These options make commuting to and from Al Quoz both efficient and accessible.

Supermarkets in and Around Al Quoz

The community of Al Quoz boasts a range of convenient shopping options, with numerous small marts scattered across its neighborhoods. For families stocking up on essentials, supermarkets like Jubily Supermarket, Sky Star Grocery, and Abdallah Ketait Grocery in Al Quoz 4 offer a variety of products.

Other popular choices include Sultan Al Madina Supermarket, Najmath Al Madina Supermarket, Azhr Al Madina Hypermarket, and Sahat Al Madina Supermarket, catering to everyday needs. For those seeking fresh meat and organic produce, West Zone Supermarket, just a 7-minute drive away, remains a top pick among residents.

Shopping Mall in and Near Al Quoz

The vibrant subcommunity of Al Quoz 1 is home to the Oasis Centre, the largest mall in the area. This bustling destination offers a complete shopping, dining, and entertainment experience. With numerous retail stores, diverse restaurants, and the family-favorite Fun City theme park, it’s a hub of activity for residents and visitors alike.
In addition to the Oasis Centre, Al Quoz enjoys proximity to the iconic Mall of the Emirates in nearby Al Barsha. Renowned for its luxury shopping outlets, world-class dining options, and unique attractions, it’s a must-visit for entertainment seekers. Highlights include Ski Dubai, an indoor ski resort; Magic Planet, a vibrant arcade and amusement park; and VOX Cinemas, featuring a state-of-the-art laser IMAX theater, ensuring something for everyone.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Al Quoz

Al Quoz offers a selection of reputable schools catering to various educational needs. Centrally located, Clarion School follows the US Common Core curriculum, focusing on progressive, activity-based learning through play, personal experiences, and social interactions. Other notable options in the area include GEMS Our Own Indian School and Oaktree Primary School.

For younger children, nurseries are available in nearby Al Barsha 2, such as Dewdrop Nursery, Cherry Town Nursery, and Seashells Nursery, providing a nurturing environment for early learning.

Higher education options include Jumeira University, situated on Latifa Bint Hamdan Street in Al Quoz 4. For a wider range of universities, Dubai Knowledge Park is a convenient 16 to 19-minute drive, offering institutions like Heriot-Watt University, Murdoch University Dubai, Middlesex University Dubai, and the University of Wollongong Dubai.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Al Quoz

Muslim residents in Al Quoz have convenient access to several mosques within the community, making daily prayers easily manageable.

For Christian residents, there are churches in and around Al Quoz, including The Gatekeepers Weekday Warehouse, Emirates Baptist Church, and Fellowship: A Christian Church in Dubai, all located within an 8 to 17-minute drive. St. Mary’s Catholic Church, one of Dubai’s most renowned churches, is just 15 minutes away on Oud Mehta Road via Al Khail Road (E44).

The nearest gurdwaras, Automech Gurudwara and Gurudwara Al Aweer, are located in Ras Al Khor Industrial Area 2, about a 17 to 20-minute drive away, while Guru Nanak Darbar in Jebel Ali is reachable in 22 minutes. Hindu residents can visit the Shiva Temple in the Za’abeel community, a short 15-minute drive from Al Quoz.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Al Quoz

The area is home to several clinics offering top-notch healthcare services. Notable options include Aster Clinic, Medilife Polyclinic LLC, Toronto Medical Center, Al Quoz City Star Polyclinic, Syed Sadiq Clinic, Noor Al Shefa Clinic, and Access Clinic, all providing comprehensive medical care to residents.

For additional healthcare services, the iCare Clinic, located on Al Wahda Street just across Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), is a convenient option. Burjeel Hospital for Advanced Surgery, situated near Al Serkal Avenue on Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), is only a 10-minute drive away. Renowned for its superior orthopedic treatments, it is a popular choice among residents.

Location & Nearby Areas

Al Quoz is strategically located between some of Dubai’s most vibrant communities, connected by major roads like Al Khail Road (E44) and Sheikh Zayed Road (E11). To the east lies the bustling district of Business Bay, while Al Barsha and Al Manara are located to the west. Across Sheikh Zayed Road to the north is Umm Suqeim 1, offering easy access to beaches and leisure spots.

Bounded by Al Wasl to the north and Al Safa, Umm Al Sheif, and Al Manara to the west, Al Quoz forms a long rectangle nestled between Al Khail Road (E44) and Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), making it a well-connected and centrally positioned community.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Quoz

data.answer:
Al Quoz offers a vibrant arts and cultural scene with attractions like Alserkal Avenue, home to contemporary art galleries, creative spaces, and unique cafes. Residents can also explore the Oasis Centre for shopping, dining, and family-friendly entertainment.

Restaurants in and Around Al Quoz

Al Quoz is a culinary hub, offering a mix of approximately 200 eateries, ranging from casual cafeterias to upscale dining spots. Many of the cafeterias specialize in Indian, Pakistani, and Arabian cuisines, with popular choices including Sabir Afghan Restaurant, Royal Darbar Restaurant, Madras Kitchen at Al Khail Gate, and Shehar-e-Karachi. Casual favorites like Raju Omlet and Chennai Darbar also add to the vibrant dining scene.

For a more refined experience, restaurants near Al Quoz such as Tom & Serg, Lime Tree Cafe, Nizar Restaurant, and Soho Cafe are perfect for those seeking upscale ambiance and gourmet dishes. The neighborhood’s nightlife is equally lively, with venues like The Red Lion at Metropolitan Hotel, just 11 minutes away, offering a great spot to unwind.

Beaches Near Al Quoz

Residents of Al Quoz can enjoy easy access to nearby beaches with a short drive. The closest option is Kite Beach, just 12 minutes away by car. This popular destination offers more than just sun and sand, featuring a variety of eateries like 25/55 Burgers, La Vedette Café, Taste of Brazil, and Vicki da Dhaba. Families will appreciate the beach's play areas, complete with swings, slides, monkey bars, and a jungle gym, making it a great spot for both relaxation and fun.

Hotels in and Around Al Quoz

Al Quoz offers more than just residential and commercial properties, with a few notable hotels adding to its diverse accommodation options. Two prominent hotels in Al Quoz are the Ascot Hotel and Urban Al Khoory, both providing excellent amenities for travelers and visitors.

The Ascot Hotel, located in Al Quoz Industrial Area 1, is a 4-star establishment offering comfortable guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, minibars, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy facilities such as an outdoor pool, sauna, steam room, and 24-hour room service, along with dry cleaning and laundry services.
Urban Al Khoory, conveniently situated off Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), combines modern design with exceptional service. This hotel features fully equipped guest rooms with amenities such as free Wi-Fi, HD interactive TVs, mini-fridges, and in-room safes. Additional offerings include concierge services, an on-call doctor (subject to surcharges), and meeting rooms with state-of-the-art audio-visual equipment, making it a versatile choice among hotels in Al Quoz.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Al Quoz offers recreational options for residents, including Al Quoz Park 3, a small park featuring a volleyball court and sandy grounds. For a more scenic and relaxing experience, Al Quoz Pond Park is a popular choice with lush green spaces surrounding an artificial pond. Larger in size, it’s perfect for families, offering plenty of grassy areas for kids to play and attracting various bird species, creating a serene atmosphere.

Fitness enthusiasts will find numerous gyms in the area, such as Power Gym Al Quoz, Al Maqta Gym, 24 Fitness Dubai, GymNation Al Quoz, York Life Fitness Gym, and Smart Life Fitness Gym, ensuring a range of options to stay active.

For personal grooming, Al Quoz is home to several beauty salons, including Oro Rosa Ladies Beauty Salon, Alsayah Gents Salon, Golden Star Gents Salon, Top To Toe Beauty Center at Oasis Village, and Better Gents Salon, catering to both men and women.

Community Events

Al Quoz community is widely recognized for hosting major events. Residents can also enjoy the vibrant monthly market held at Al Khail Gate, just a short drive away along Al Khail Road. Taking place on the first Friday of each month, this event creates a lively, carnival-like atmosphere with fun activities for all ages. Children can participate in games and competitions, while adults can join in various engaging activities, making it a delightful outing for families.

Attractions and Landmarks

Conveniently located near some of Dubai's trendiest bars and clubs, Al Quoz is just 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport. Mall of the Emirates is only a 12-minute drive, while Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa are just 10 minutes away, offering easy access to world-class attractions and landmarks.

Al Quoz offers a peaceful and family-friendly environment, making it an ideal place to call home. Its unique blend of residential and commercial spaces adds to its vibrant character, with a dynamic atmosphere created by its thriving industrial hub.

What is Al Quoz known for?

Al Quoz is known for its unique blend of residential, commercial, and industrial areas. It is home to a thriving arts and culture scene, with Alserkal Avenue being a popular hub for galleries, creative spaces, and events.

Are there good residential options in Al Quoz?

Yes, Al Quoz offers a variety of residential properties, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, catering to different lifestyles and preferences.

What are the main attractions in Al Quoz?

Key attractions in Al Quoz include Alserkal Avenue for art and culture, the Oasis Centre mall for shopping and dining, and Al Quoz Pond Park for outdoor leisure. It is also conveniently located near major landmarks like Downtown Dubai and Mall of the Emirates.

How is the public transport in Al Quoz?

Al Quoz is well-connected by major roads like Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Khail Road (E44). The nearest metro station is the Onpassive Metro Station on the Red Line, and there are several bus stops in and around the area.

Are there schools and nurseries in Al Quoz?

Yes, Al Quoz has several reputable schools such as Clarion School and GEMS Our Own Indian School, along with nurseries like Dewdrop Nursery and Cherry Town Nursery nearby.

Are there restaurants in Al Quoz?

Al Quoz features a wide range of dining options, from casual eateries serving Indian, Pakistani, and Arabian cuisines to upscale restaurants like Tom & Serg and Lime Tree Cafe.

Can I find fitness and grooming facilities in Al Quoz?

Absolutely. Al Quoz has numerous gyms, including GymNation and Power Gym, as well as beauty salons like Oro Rosa Ladies Beauty Salon and Golden Star Gents Salon for personal grooming.

Is Al Quoz a good place for families?

Yes, Al Quoz is a family-friendly community with peaceful residential areas, green spaces like Al Quoz Pond Park, and a variety of amenities suitable for families.

data.content:
Al Quoz Dubai is a prominent mixed-use district strategically located between Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Khail Road (E44). Spanning 27.1 sq. km., it is divided into residential and commercial sectors. The residential areas, primarily in the northeastern region, include Al Quoz 1, Al Quoz 2, and Al Quoz 4, offering a variety of apartments, villas, and townhouses.

The commercial side, known as the Al Quoz Industrial Area, forms the southern part of the community and is one of the oldest industrial hubs in Dubai. This area, which includes Al Quoz Industrial Areas 1, 2, 3, and 4, features factories, warehouses, and auto shops, and continues to be developed by Dubai Municipality to meet the city's growing industrial needs.

Al Quoz UAE stands out for its unique blend of residential and commercial opportunities. While the residential zones provide family-friendly living spaces, the industrial areas are ideal for businesses seeking shops, offices, and labor camps. This dynamic environment makes Al Quoz Dubai a versatile and highly sought-after community in the UAE.
